intro: Horde Trauma is a summons directing accomplished Horde medics to report to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Doctor Gregory Victor, the chief physician of the Horde's trauma division, is looking to recruit and evaluate skilled hands capable of saving lives under extreme pressure. Answering the call places a medic directly into the grim, high-stakes reality of front-line field surgery.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Doctor friend, I presume. It is a pleasure to see you again.

I have some wonderful news for you! Doctor Gregory Victor, chief physician of Horde Trauma has made a personal request for you to join him at Hammerfall. This could be the opportunity of a lifetime! I would give anything to be given a chance to study under the great Doctor Gregory Victor! Do not squander this opportunity!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful. Put on your scrubs, we are to start at once!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
